description: MATSim Switzerland freight scenario provides a MATSim model of Swiss inland freight, with road-only and intermodal road-rail movements. The provider is Swiss Federal Railways / SBB. Geographical and temporal coverage: Swiss Federal Railways developed the national Switzerland freight scenario; each container's movement is represented within the model. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
